WHY GOOGLE ADS WORKS
High-intent buyers are already searching. Your campaign just needs to catch them first.

Someone searching for "best dental clinic in Rawalpindi" or "interior designer Islamabad" is already in buying mode. Google Ads lets your business appear at the exact moment demand already exists.

CAMPAIGN TYPES WE RUN
Different Google campaign types for different buyer journeys and business goals.
SEARCH ADS
Show at the top when people search your exact service.

Best for high-intent service keywords and urgent buyer demand.

LOCAL ADS
Appear in Google Maps and city-based local searches.

Strong for clinics, restaurants, salons, contractors, and city-specific businesses.

DISPLAY ADS
Visual banner ads for awareness and retargeting.

Useful when you want reach, reminders, and repeated brand exposure.

CALL ADS
Direct phone call ads designed for mobile users.

Great for businesses where leads convert faster over calls than forms.

PERFORMANCE MAX
AI-powered campaigns across Google's full ad ecosystem.

Built for broader reach when supported with stronger tracking and creative assets.

WHY GOOGLE ADS OUTPERFORMS META ADS FOR CERTAIN BUSINESSES
Google captures existing demand. Meta helps create demand. The best strategy often combines both.

Meta Ads are powerful for awareness, attention, and retargeting. Google Ads are stronger when buyers actively search for services like lawyers, doctors, contractors, consultants, and other intent-driven categories.

Google Ads
Captures people already in purchase mode, often producing higher-quality leads and stronger conversion rates.
Meta Ads
Works well for reaching cold audiences, generating interest, and staying visible before they search.
Integrated Strategy
Google handles intent capture while Meta drives awareness and retargeting inside one connected campaign structure.
INTEGRATED CAMPAIGN ENGINE

Crea8iv Media can run both Google Ads and Meta Ads together for a cleaner, more profitable acquisition system.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Budget, timeline, and location coverage answered clearly.
What is the minimum Google Ads budget for businesses in Pakistan?
BUDGET GUIDANCE
+

We typically recommend a minimum ad spend of PKR 40,000 to 60,000 per month so the campaign can gather enough data for meaningful optimization. Management fee is separate. Smaller budgets can still work in low-competition niches.

How is Google Ads different from SEO?
SPEED VS LONG-TERM
+

Google Ads can put your business at the top of Google within 24 hours of launch, making it the fastest path for immediate leads. SEO takes longer but builds sustainable organic visibility over time, so both work well together.

Do you manage Google Ads for businesses outside Rawalpindi?
COVERAGE AREAS
+

Yes. We manage campaigns across Pakistan including Lahore, Karachi, Faisalabad, and Peshawar, and we also support UK-based clients in competitive local markets.

Google Ads in Rawalpindi & Islamabad

Frequently Asked Questions
How much do Google Ads cost in Pakistan?

Google Ads management starts from PKR 25,000/month plus ad spend. A typical Rawalpindi or Islamabad business sees strong results with PKR 30,000–50,000/month in ad budget, depending on the service and competition.

Are Google Ads better than Facebook Ads?

They're different tools. Google Ads capture high-intent buyers searching right now; Meta Ads create demand and retarget. Most businesses win fastest by combining both — we build them to work together.

How fast do Google Ads start working?

Google Ads can generate calls and leads within days of launch because they target active searchers. We then optimize keywords and bids over the first weeks to lower cost per lead.

What is a good cost per lead on Google Ads in Pakistan?

It varies by industry, but for most local services a cost per lead of PKR 200–800 is achievable with tight targeting, strong ad copy and a fast landing page.

Do you build the landing page too?

Yes. A fast, conversion-focused landing page is essential for Google Ads ROI — we build or optimize it so paid clicks turn into real inquiries.
